financial_literacy_modules.regulatoryAgency: Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying / General Insurance Companies
financial_literacy_modules.coverageScope: Covers accidental death, disease/illness, surgical complications, natural calamities (cyclone, lightning, flood), and permanent total disability of milch cows, Murrah buffaloes, bullocks, and breeding stock.
financial_literacy_modules.premiumAndSubsidy: Standard gross premium is approx 3.0% - 4.5% of the animal's assessed market valuation per year. Under Centrally Sponsored Schemes, small/marginal farmers, women, and SC/ST/OBC beneficiaries receive a 50% to 70% government premium subsidy (effective net farmer contribution is only approx 1.0% - 1.5% of animal value).
financial_literacy_modules.identificationMandate: Mandatory microchip RFID ear-tagging or 12-digit visual polyurethane ear-tag issued by an authorized veterinary surgeon. The intact ear tag is mandatory for claim processing ('No Tag, No Claim' rule).
financial_literacy_modules.claimProcedure: In the event of animal mortality: 1) Immediate intimation to the insurance company/bank within 24 hours, 2) Mandatory post-mortem examination by a government Veterinary Assistant Surgeon (VAS), 3) Submission of post-mortem certificate along with the retrieved intact ear tag and claim form.
financial_literacy_modules.importantExclusions: Intentional slaughter, theft/untraceable loss, pre-existing diseases prior to policy inception, failure to vaccinate during government immunization drives.

financial_literacy_modules.topic: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Insurance
financial_literacy_modules.regulatoryAgency: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
financial_literacy_modules.coverageScope: Comprehensive risk coverage across complete crop cycle: 1) Prevented sowing / planting risk due to deficit rainfall, 2) Standing crop yield loss due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, pests, diseases), 3) Post-harvest localized losses (cyclone, unseasonal rains while crop is drying in field for up to 14 days).
financial_literacy_modules.premiumStructure: Statutory subsidized premium caps for farmers: 2.0% for Kharif crops (Paddy, Cotton, Maize), 1.5% for Rabi crops (Wheat, Gram, Mustard), 5.0% for annual commercial/horticultural crops (Chilli, Turmeric, Sugarcane). Balance actuarial premium is shared 50:50 by Central and State Governments.
financial_literacy_modules.enrollmentAndClaim: Available to both loanee and non-loanee farmers. Claims are settled directly into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account based on Crop Cutting Experiments (CCE) and localized weather station data.
financial_literacy_modules.importantExclusions: War and nuclear risks, malicious damage, preventable pest neglect.

financial_literacy_modules.topic: Bank Deposit & Savings Products for Rural Entrepreneurs

products.purpose: Day-to-day liquidity, receipts of digital UPI payments, DBT subsidies, and working cash buffer
products.interestConcept: Modest interest (calculated on daily end-of-day balance, credited quarterly)
products.recommendation: Maintain a minimum 1-month operational working capital reserve in a liquid savings account.

products.purpose: Lump-sum wealth preservation and risk-free growth of excess profits or harvest windfalls
products.tenure: Fixed tenure from 7 days to 10 years (typically 1 to 3 years for optimal compounding)
products.interestConcept: Guaranteed fixed interest rate locked for the entire tenure, compounded quarterly. Senior citizens and women often receive 0.25% - 0.50% higher interest.
products.prematureWithdrawal: Permitted at any time, but subject to a nominal penalty (usually 0.5% - 1.0% deduction from the applicable rate) and loss of full compounding interest.

products.purpose: Disciplined monthly savings from regular business surplus to accumulate capital for future asset purchases
products.tenure: Fixed monthly installments over 6 months to 10 years
products.interestConcept: Earns the same high guaranteed interest rate as a Fixed Deposit, compounding each installment quarterly.
products.recommendation: RuralCred recommends allocating 25% of monthly net cash surplus into a 12-month RD to build a 3-month operating emergency runway.

financial_literacy_modules.depositSafetyGuarantee: All bank deposits (Savings, FD, RD) in Scheduled Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and Co-operative Banks are insured up to ₹5,00,000 per depositor by the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation (DICGC - 100% RBI subsidiary).
